item.subject: science
item.stem: Ravi is a 13-year-old student in a school in Pune. His teacher asks the class to suggest a healthy growth plan for adolescents. Which plan is the best choice for Ravi's healthy growth?

options.A: Eat a varied nutritious diet with proteins, carbohydrates, fats, vitamins and minerals, and take part in regular exercise and games
options.B: Eat a varied nutritious diet every day, but avoid all exercise and physical games because they are not needed
options.C: Eat only his favourite filling food such as rice and potatoes, with no need for other nutrients or exercise
options.D: Eat a varied nutritious diet and exercise only until he reaches adult height, then stop both
